# The Exchange autosync test waits for its target folder and asserts a message count and Offline flag

The new EWS and Graph tasks each add one generated message, drive AutoSync through startup/app-idle observer calls, and await a listener watching the target folder. Their direct assertions check one total message and its Offline bit. The listener's error callback only logs, and the manager can notify a completed group before handling remaining pending messages. These tests do not directly prove body-byte integrity, every download group, retry failures or wire equivalence.

Scope: Exchange EWS/Graph AutoSync test boundary.
